written.headline: Big tech firms commit over $3 trillion to AI data‑center spending
written.summary: Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon and Oracle have disclosed more than $3 trillion in commitments for data‑center leases, equipment and energy over the coming years. Alphabet leads with over $1 trillion and Meta with more than $800 billion.

written.headline: Apple rolls out Apple Intelligence features in China with iOS 27.3 beta
written.summary: Apple announced that iOS 27.3 beta, releasing Nov 4, will bring several Apple Intelligence tools to iPhone 15 Pro and newer in China, with a full public release slated for December. The rollout excludes Siri AI and other new features.

written.headline: TRAI drafts AI policy framework requiring board approval and incident reporting for telecoms
written.summary: India's Telecom Regulatory Authority released draft guidelines that mandate telecom operators to classify AI systems by risk, adopt board‑approved AI policies, set up governance committees and report serious AI incidents to the regulator. The framework applies whether AI is built in‑house or sourced from third parties.

written.headline: Intel stock falls 28% after weak Q4 outlook, erasing $12B from US government stake
written.summary: Intel shares dropped about 28% on Friday after the company forecast fourth‑quarter revenue of $15‑$16 billion and a lower gross profit margin. The decline wiped roughly $12 billion from the U.S. government’s 10% stake in the chipmaker.
